name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship - Postdoctoral
funder: Swiss Confederation (Federal Commission for Scholarships for Foreign Students, ESKAS)
amount: CHF 2,450/month + Swiss health insurance + CHF 600 housing grant + return airfare + half-fare travelcard (figures for Indian applicants; may vary by country)
other_rules: Recent PhD (definition and age limits set per country)
signed letter of acceptance from a full professor at a Swiss university is mandatory
apply through the Swiss embassy in your country
notes: For India, dossiers due at the Swiss Embassy in New Delhi by mid-November 2026 (date estimated); decisions by May 2027, start 1 Sep 2027. Each country has its own deadline; check the embassy.
